fundamental.summary: UNH shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 91 days adds timing risk.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (344.64), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, and rising USD pressuring multinationals; earnings 91 days out provides minimal near-term binary risk but overall environment is highly unfavourable.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with positive MACD crossover and rising RSI-9 provides technical momentum entry signal in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis, 34/100 fear-greed).
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought conditions (RSI-21, Williams %R), weak trend strength (ADX 18.38), zero fundamental/smart money support, unfavourable macro (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, strong USD), and earnings risk in 91 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup.
